s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Belt Assembly Outer

s2.ptxt: ELR Lock Start Tilt Angle Inspection

s3.ptxt: When the retractor is moved slowly from the installed position, check that the belt does not lock within 15° in all directions, and that it remains locked at 45° or more.

s2.ptxt: Install the rear seat belt assembly outer with the nut.
Install the rear seat belt assembly outer with the bolt.

atten3.ptxt: Install it so that the floor anchor does not ride up on the locating part.

s2.ptxt: ELR Lock Inspection

s3.ptxt: With the belt installed on the vehicle, check that the belt locks when pulled out quickly.

s-1.ptxt: Install Deck Trim Side Panel Assembly RH

s2.ptxt: Pass the rear seat outer belt assembly RH through the guide of the deck trim side panel assembly RH.
Engage the 2 claws and 4 clips, and install the deck trim side panel assembly RH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the back door weatherstrip is not caught in the deck trim side panel assembly RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Luggage Hold Belt Striker Assembly (Installation Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Install the trunk (luggage compartment) hold belt striker with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Side Garnish RH

s2.ptxt: Pass the rear seat outer belt assembly RH through the guide of the rear seat side garnish RH.
Engage the 6 claws and 2 clips, and install the rear seat side garnish RH.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seatback Hinge Sub-assembly (Installation Position RH Side)

s2.ptxt: Install the rear seatback hinge with the bolt.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Opening Trim Weatherstrip RH

s2.ptxt: Align the paint mark (white) of the weatherstrip with the arrow part on the body side shown in the illustration, and install the rear door opening trim weatherstrip RH.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the corners are not lifted.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Door Scuff Plate RH

s2.ptxt: Engage the 8 claws to install the rear door scuff plate RH.
Set the rear seat assembly RH in the vehicle, and install the 2 rear side bolts in the order inner → outer.
Raise the seatback, and install the 2 front side bolts of the rear seat assembly RH in the order inner → outer.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.2

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.2.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Cushion Hinge Cover NO.1

s2.ptxt: Engage the 4 claws and install the rear seat cushion hinge cover NO.1.

s-1.ptxt: Install Rear Seat Headrest Assembly Center

s2.ptxt: Engage the 10 claws to install the deck trim cover rear.

atten3.ptxt: After installation, check that the back door weatherstrip is not caught in the deck trim cover rear.

s-1.ptxt: Install Luggage Hold Belt Striker Assembly (Installation Position Rear Side)

s2.ptxt: Install the trunk (luggage compartment) hold belt striker with the bolt.

atten4.ptxt: Install the LH side using the same procedure.

s2.ptxt: Insert the guide.
Install the deck floor box RH with the 2 nuts.
Install the rear floor mat rear.

s2.ptxt: Engage the package tray trim panel assembly with the 2 pins.
Connect the 2 suspenders to the package tray trim garnish hooks, and install the package tray trim panel assembly.
